name: github-source
description: Pull tasks from GitHub Issues or PR comment threads, write results back
author: Denislav Prinov

configSchema.label: GitHub token
configSchema.help: Optional, shared by both GitHub sources. Fine-grained PAT (Issues R/W + Metadata R; add Pull requests R/W for the PR comments source) or {"$env":"GH_TOKEN"}. Leave blank to use the account the `gh` CLI is logged in as — note that token's scopes are usually far broader than this plugin needs

configSchema.label: Close issue on completion
configSchema.help: yes = close the issue (state_reason: completed) when a pipeline finishes successfully

configSchema.label: GitHub token
configSchema.help: Optional, shared with the GitHub Issues source. Fine-grained PAT with Pull requests: Read and write + Metadata: Read-only (replying and resolving threads needs write), or {"$env":"GH_TOKEN"}. Blank = the `gh` CLI's logged-in account

configSchema.label: Resolve thread on completion
configSchema.help: yes = resolve the review thread (GraphQL resolveReviewThread) after replying, when a pipeline finishes successfully. Only diff-anchored review threads can be resolved
